subject: Fix pre-push hook hanging on lint and build in git worktrees
description: The husky pre-push hook hangs when running lint and build before pushing to GitHub, particularly in git worktree setups. Known issue: stdin inheritance causes the hook process to hang. Investigate root cause and fix — likely needs stdin redirection (`< /dev/null`), timeouts, or restructuring the hook script. Test in both main repo and worktree contexts.
